title: It Kept Coming Back
sentences: The Black Death wasn't the end.
Plague returned to Europe again and again for more than three hundred years.
A second wave in 1361 hit children especially hard.
London's Great Plague of 1665 killed around a hundred thousand people.
Marseille suffered one of the last big outbreaks, in 1720.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
The Black Death wasn’t the end. Plague kept returning for 300 years.
